lessons.name: Bitta va ko'p
lessons.goal: Bola bitta va ko'p narsani farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Salom, bolajonlar! Men — Kabutar qushcha. Qarang, daraxtda olmalar bor. Bittasi menga, qolgani sizlarga! Keling, bitta va ko'pni o'rganamiz.

items.image_prompt: One single red apple, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qarang, bu yerda bitta olma bor. Barmog'imizni bitta qilib ko'rsatamiz: bitta! Olma yolg'iz, u — bitta.

items.image_prompt: A big pile of many red apples, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Endi qarang, savatda olmalar ko'p. Bir, ikki, uch, yana, yana… Juda ko'p! Qo'llarimizni keng ochamiz: ko'p!

tests.q: Kabutar qushcha nechta? Bitta yoki ko'p?

extra.matn: Bitta barmoq — bitta, bitta! Ko'p barmoqlar — ko'p, ko'p, ko'p! Qani, men bilan birga kuylang va barmoqlarni ko'rsating!
extra.sodda: Bitta barmoq ko'rsating. Endi hamma barmoqlarni — ko'p!
extra.boshqa_usul: Bitta qarsak chaling. Endi ko'p-ko'p qarsak chaling!

lessons.name: Ko'pdan bitta
lessons.goal: Bola ko'p narsadan bittasini ajratib oladi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Mening idishimda konfetlar ko'p. Men sizga bittadan beraman. Qani, kim bittasini oladi?

items.image_prompt: A bowl of many candies and one candy taken out by a small hand, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Idishda konfetlar ko'p. Men bittasini olaman. Qo'limda endi bitta konfet. Ko'pdan bitta oldik!

items.image_prompt: Two children each holding one candy, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Aliga bitta konfet, Zeboga ham bitta konfet. Har biriga bittadan! Hamma xursand.

tests.q: Har bir bolaga bittadan olma berdik. Qaysi rasm?

extra.matn: Uydagi o'yinchoqlarga bittadan qoshiq bering: ayiqchaga bitta, qo'g'irchoqqa bitta. Kimga qoshiq yetmadi?
extra.boshqa_usul: Qoshiq o'rniga bittadan olma yoki kubik bering.

lessons.name: Bo'sh va to'la savat
lessons.goal: Bola bo'sh va to'la savatni farqlaydi, bitta va ko'pni mustahkamlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bir sir bor: mening savatim bo'sh edi. Keyin nima bo'ldi? Keling, ko'ramiz!

items.image_prompt: An empty wicker basket, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Savatga qarang. Uning ichida hech narsa yo'q. Savat bo'sh. Qo'llarimizni yoyamiz: yo'q!

items.image_prompt: A wicker basket full of red apples, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Endi savatga olmalarni ko'p soldik. Savat to'la! Olmalar ko'p, joy qolmadi.

tests.why: Barakalla! Bu savatda hech narsa yo'q.
Ofarin! Savatda olma ko'p, u to'la.

tests.q: Tarelkada bitta nok bor. Qaysi rasm?

lessons.name: Katta va kichik
lessons.goal: Bola katta va kichik hayvonlarni farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bugun hayvonot bog'iga boramiz. U yerda juda katta va juda kichik do'stlar bor. Kimlar ekan?

items.image_prompt: A big friendly elephant, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Mana fil. Fil juda katta! Qo'llarimizni tepaga cho'zamiz: katta, katta!

items.image_prompt: A tiny little mouse, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Mana sichqoncha. U juda kichik! O'tirib, kichkina bo'lamiz: kichik, kichik!

extra.matn: Men «katta» desam — qo'llaringizni tepaga cho'zing. «Kichik» desam — o'tiring. Katta! Kichik! Katta!
extra.boshqa_usul: Katta desam katta qadam, kichik desam kichik qadam tashlang.

lessons.name: Katta ayiq, kichik ayiqcha
lessons.goal: Bola bir xil narsalarning kattasi va kichigini topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! O'rmonda ayiqlar oilasi yashaydi: katta ayiq va kichik ayiqcha. Keling, ular bilan tanishamiz!

items.image_prompt: A big brown bear standing, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — ayiq dada. U katta, kuchli. Katta qadam tashlaydi: dup, dup!

items.image_prompt: A small cute teddy bear cub, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — ayiqcha. U kichik, yumshoq. Kichik qadam tashlaydi: tip, tip.

items.image_prompt: A big tree next to a tiny green sprout, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qarang, daraxt katta, baland. Yonida kichik nihol o'syapti. Nihol hali kichik, keyin o'sadi.

tests.q: Qaysi biri kichik: daraxtmi yoki nihol?

lessons.name: Ona va bolasi
lessons.goal: Bola katta ona va kichik bolasini topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Ko'lda o'rdak ona suzyapti, orqasida kichkina o'rdakcha. Kim katta, kim kichik? Keling, topamiz!

items.image_prompt: A big mother duck swimming, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — ona o'rdak. U katta. Qanotlarini keng ochadi: katta!

items.image_prompt: A tiny yellow duckling, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — o'rdakcha. U kichik, sariq, yumshoq. Onasidan kichik.

items.image_prompt: A big watermelon next to a small cherry, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Tarvuz katta, uni ikki qo'llab ko'taramiz. Olcha kichik, uni bitta barmoq bilan olamiz.

extra.matn: Katta o'rdak — g'aq-g'aq-g'aq! Kichik jo'ja — chiy-chiy-chiy! Katta ovoz, kichik ovoz — qani, birga kuylaymiz!
extra.sodda: Katta ovozda: g'aq! Kichik ovozda: chiy!
extra.boshqa_usul: Katta o'rdakdek yuring, keyin kichik jo'jadek yuring.

lessons.name: Paypoq jufti
lessons.goal: Bola ikkita bir xil narsani — juftni topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Voy, mening paypoqlarim aralashib ketdi! Qaysi biri qaysisiga juft? Yordam berasizmi?

items.image_prompt: Two identical red apples side by side, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qarang, ikkala olma bir xil: ikkalasi qizil, ikkalasi dumaloq. Ular xuddi o'xshash — bir xil!

items.image_prompt: A pair of identical striped socks, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu ikki paypoq bir xil. Ular — juft! Bittasi o'ng oyoqqa, bittasi chap oyoqqa kiyiladi.

tests.why: Barakalla! Ikkalasi ham olma — bir xil.

lessons.name: Poyabzal va qo'lqop
lessons.goal: Bola kiyimlar juftini topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Tashqarida sovuq. Qo'lqop va poyabzal kiyamiz. Lekin har biri juft bo'lishi kerak!

items.image_prompt: A pair of small children's sneakers, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Mana ikki poyabzal. Ular bir xil, ular juft. Bittasini o'ng oyoqqa, bittasini chap oyoqqa kiyamiz.

items.image_prompt: A pair of warm knitted mittens, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qo'lqoplar ham juft bo'ladi. Ikkala qo'limizga bittadan kiyamiz. Ikkala qo'l issiq!

tests.why: Barakalla! Ikki poyabzal bir xil — juft.

extra.matn: Uydan paypoqlarni olib, aralashtiring. Qani, har bir paypoqning juftini topib, yonma-yon qo'ying!
extra.sodda: Bitta paypoq oling va xuddi o'shandayini qidiring.
extra.boshqa_usul: Paypoq o'rniga qoshiq va poyabzallarni juftlang.

lessons.name: Onasini top
lessons.goal: Bola hayvon onasi va bolasini juftlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Kichkina jo'ja adashib qoldi! U onasini qidiryapti. Keling, har bir bolaga onasini topib beramiz!

items.image_prompt: A mother hen with a little yellow chick, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Jo'ja chiy-chiy deydi. Uning onasi — tovuq. Tovuq katta, jo'ja kichik. Ular — juft!

items.image_prompt: A mother cat with a small kitten, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Mushukcha miyov deydi. Uning onasi — mushuk. Onasi katta, bolasi kichik.

extra.matn: Siz mushukcha bo'ling: miyov! Men ona mushuk: miyov-miyov! Endi siz jo'ja: chiy-chiy! Ona tovuq keldi: qoq-qoq!
extra.boshqa_usul: Onangiz bilan birga hayvon onasi va bolasi bo'lib o'ynang.

lessons.name: Qizil va sariq
lessons.goal: Bola qizil va sariq rangni taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Mening bo'yoqlarim bor. Bugun ikkita quvnoq rang bilan tanishamiz. Olma qanday rangda? Banan-chi?

items.image_prompt: A red circle next to a red apple, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Olma — qizil. Qulupnay ham qizil. Qizil rangni topib, barmoq bilan ko'rsating!

items.image_prompt: A yellow circle next to a yellow banana, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Banan — sariq. Quyosh ham sariq, jo'ja ham sariq. Qani, sariq narsani toping!

lessons.name: Ko'k va yashil
lessons.goal: Bola ko'k va yashil rangni taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men osmonda uchaman. Tepada osmon, pastda o't. Ular qanday rangda ekan? Keling, bilib olamiz!

items.image_prompt: A blue circle next to a blue whale, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Osmon — ko'k. Kit ham ko'k. Ko'k rangni topib, barmoq bilan ko'rsating!

items.image_prompt: A green circle next to a green cucumber, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: O't — yashil. Bodring ham yashil, qurbaqa ham yashil. Qani, yashil narsani toping!

extra.matn: Qizil olma, sariq banan, ko'k osmon, yashil o't! Qani, har rangni aytganda o'sha rangni ko'rsating!
extra.boshqa_usul: Uydan to'rt rangdagi o'yinchoq topib keling.

lessons.name: Rangiga qarab ter
lessons.goal: Bola narsalarni rangiga qarab ikki guruhga ajratadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Mening kubiklarim aralashib ketdi: qizil ham, yashil ham. Keling, har birini o'z uyiga teramiz!

items.image_prompt: Red strawberry and red cherries grouped together, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qulupnay qizil, olcha ham qizil. Ularning rangi bir xil. Ular birga turadi.

items.image_prompt: Two baskets, one with red balls, one with green balls, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qizillarni qizil savatga, yashillarni yashil savatga solamiz. Mana, hammasi o'z joyida!

extra.matn: Kubik yoki qalamlarni oling. Qizillarini bir joyga, yashillarini boshqa joyga qo'ying. Qaysi to'p ko'p?

lessons.name: Doira
lessons.goal: Bola doirani taniydi va dumaloq narsalarni topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men bir shakl topdim. U burchaksiz, dumaloq, xuddi quyoshday! Uning nomi nima ekan?

items.image_prompt: A simple white circle shape, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — doira. Uning burchagi yo'q, u dumaloq. Barmog'ingiz bilan havoda doira chizing!

items.image_prompt: A round ball and a round cookie, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: To'p dumaloq, pechenye ham dumaloq. Ular doiraga o'xshaydi. To'p dumalaydi!

extra.matn: Keling, qo'l ushlashib katta doira bo'lamiz! Endi aylanamiz, aylanamiz — doira bo'ldik!
extra.boshqa_usul: Arqon yoki ip bilan polga doira qiling.

lessons.name: Kvadrat
lessons.goal: Bola kvadratni taniydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Doira bilan tanishdik. Endi uning do'sti keldi. Uning to'rtta burchagi bor! Kim ekan?

items.image_prompt: A simple red square shape, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — kvadrat. Uning burchaklari bor: mana bitta, mana yana… To'rtta burchak! Tomonlari bir xil.

items.image_prompt: A square gift box and a square waffle, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Sovg'a qutisi kvadratga o'xshaydi. Vafli ham kvadrat. Ularning burchaklari bor.

lessons.name: Doira yoki kvadrat?
lessons.goal: Bola doira va kvadratni farqlaydi, shakl bo'yicha teradi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bir sir: bittasi dumalaydi, bittasi dumalamaydi. Qaysi biri? Keling, sinab ko'ramiz!

items.image_prompt: A round ball rolling across the floor, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: To'pni itaring — u dumalab ketadi! Chunki u dumaloq, burchagi yo'q.

items.image_prompt: A toy cube standing still on the floor, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kubikni itaring — u dumalamaydi, turib qoladi. Chunki uning burchaklari bor.

extra.matn: Stolga to'p va kubik qo'ying. Ikkalasini yengil itaring. Qaysi biri dumaladi? Qaysi biri joyida qoldi?
extra.boshqa_usul: Tovoqcha va kitobni polga qo'yib sinab ko'ring.

lessons.name: Uzun va qisqa
lessons.goal: Bola uzun va qisqani farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men bog'da ikki do'st ko'rdim: ilon va qurtcha. Biri juda uzun, biri qisqa. Qaysi biri?

items.image_prompt: A long friendly green snake stretched out, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Mana ilon. U uzun, juda uzun! Qo'llarimizni ikki tomonga keng cho'zamiz: uzun!

items.image_prompt: A short little caterpillar, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Mana qurtcha. U qisqa. Qo'llarimizni yaqin qilamiz: qisqa!

extra.matn: «Uzun» desam — qo'llaringizni keng cho'zing. «Qisqa» desam — kaftlaringizni yaqinlashtiring. Uzun! Qisqa! Uzun!
extra.boshqa_usul: Uzun desam uzun qadam, qisqa desam qisqa qadam.

lessons.name: Uzun poyezd, qisqa poyezd
lessons.goal: Bola vagonlar bo'yicha uzun va qisqa poyezdni farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Chuh-chuh! Bekatga ikkita poyezd keldi. Birining vagoni ko'p, birining vagoni kam. Qaysi biri uzun?

items.image_prompt: A long toy train with many wagons, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu poyezdning vagonlari ko'p. U uzun! Chuh-chuh, uzun poyezd ketdi!

items.image_prompt: A short toy train with one wagon, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu poyezdning vagoni bitta. U qisqa. Qisqa poyezd tez-tez yuradi.

tests.q: Qisqa poyezdda nechta vagon? Bitta yoki ko'p?

extra.matn: Chuh-chuh-chuh, poyezd ketdi, vagonlari ko'p — uzun! Chuh-chuh, kichkina poyezd — vagon bitta — qisqa!
extra.sodda: Oila bilan qator bo'lib poyezd bo'ling.
extra.boshqa_usul: Kubiklardan uzun va qisqa poyezd yasang.

lessons.name: Uzun bo'yin, qisqa dum
lessons.goal: Bola hayvonlarda uzun va qisqa qismlarni topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Kimning bo'yni juda uzun? Kimning dumi qisqa? Topishmoq! Keling, hayvonlarga qaraymiz.

items.image_prompt: A giraffe with a very long neck, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Jirafaga qarang. Uning bo'yni juda uzun! U daraxt tepasidagi barglarni yeydi.

items.image_prompt: A bunny showing its short fluffy tail, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Quyonchaga qarang. Uning dumi qisqa, yumaloq. Quloqlari esa uzun!

lessons.name: Tepada va pastda
lessons.goal: Bola tepada va pastda joylashuvini farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men uchib tepaga ko'tarildim. Pastda gullar ko'rinyapti! Tepada nima, pastda nima bor?

items.image_prompt: A fluffy cloud high in the sky, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Boshimizni ko'taramiz. Tepada bulut, tepada quyosh. Barmoq bilan tepani ko'rsating!

items.image_prompt: A tulip growing on the ground, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Endi pastga qaraymiz. Pastda gul, pastda o't. Barmoq bilan pastni ko'rsating!

lessons.name: Daraxtda nima bor?
lessons.goal: Bola daraxt tepasida va pastidagi narsalarni topadi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men daraxtga qo'ndim. Tepada meni ko'ryapsizmi? Pastda esa kim yashiringan ekan?

items.image_prompt: A small bird sitting at the top of a tree, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qushcha daraxt tepasida o'tiribdi. U yuqorida, shoxda. Chiq-chiq!

items.image_prompt: A mushroom growing under a tree, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qo'ziqorin daraxt tagida o'sibdi. U pastda, yerda.

tests.q: Olma daraxtdan tushdi. U endi qayerda?

extra.matn: Xonaga qarang. Tepada nima bor? Chiroq! Pastda nima bor? Gilam! Yana nimalarni topasiz?
extra.boshqa_usul: O'yinchoqni stol ustiga, keyin stol tagiga qo'ying.

lessons.name: Tepaga va pastga
lessons.goal: Bola tepaga va pastga harakatini bajaradi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Bugun biz raqs tushamiz! Qo'llar tepaga, qo'llar pastga. Tayyormisiz?

items.image_prompt: A child raising both hands up high, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qo'llarimizni tepaga ko'taramiz! Yuqoriga, osmonga qarab. Tepaga!

items.image_prompt: A child pointing both hands down to the floor, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Endi qo'llarni pastga tushiramiz. Yerga tegizamiz. Pastga!

tests.q: Shar uchib ketdi. U qayerga ketdi?
To'p qo'ldan tushdi. U qayerga ketdi?

extra.matn: Qo'llar tepaga — bir! Qo'llar pastga — ikki! Sakrab tepaga, o'tirib pastga! Barakalla!
extra.boshqa_usul: To'pni tepaga otib, pastga tushishini kuzating.

lessons.name: Qutining ichida
lessons.goal: Bola ichida va tashqarida joylashuvini farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Mening ayiqcham yashirindi. U qutining ichidami yoki tashqarisidami? Qani, topamiz!

items.image_prompt: A teddy bear sitting inside an open cardboard box, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ayiqcha qutining ichida o'tiribdi. U ichkarida. Ichida!

items.image_prompt: A teddy bear sitting next to a cardboard box outside, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Endi ayiqcha qutidan chiqdi. U tashqarida, qutining yonida. Tashqarida!

tests.why: To'g'ri! Bo'sh qutida hech narsa yo'q.

extra.matn: O'yinchoqni qutiga soling — ichida! Endi chiqaring — tashqarida! Qani, yana bir marta!
extra.boshqa_usul: O'zingiz katta qutiga yoki chodir ichiga kirib chiqing.

lessons.name: Uyda va hovlida
lessons.goal: Bola uy ichi va tashqarisini farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Yomg'ir yog'yapti! Mushukcha qayerga yugurdi? Uyga kirdimi yoki tashqarida qoldimi?

items.image_prompt: A kitten sleeping inside a cozy house, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Mushukcha uyning ichida. U issiq xonada uxlayapti. Ichkarida!

items.image_prompt: A puppy playing outside in a yard with a tree, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kuchukcha tashqarida, hovlida o'ynayapti. U uydan tashqarida!

lessons.name: Savat ichida olma
lessons.goal: Bola ichida va tashqarida, bitta va ko'pni birga qo'llaydi
lessons.intro: Gu-gu! Men savatga olma teryapman. Qaysi olmalar savatning ichida? Qaysilari tashqarida qoldi?

items.image_prompt: A red apple inside a wicker basket, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Olmani savatga soldik. Olma savatning ichida. Ichida!

items.image_prompt: A red apple lying on the grass next to a basket, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bitta olma yerga tushib ketdi. U savatdan tashqarida. Keling, uni ham savatga solamiz!

tests.q: Savat ichida olma ko'p. Qaysi rasm?

extra.matn: Bitta olma — savatga! Yana olma — savatga! Savat to'la, olma ko'p! Barakalla, bolajon!
extra.sodda: Olmani savatga soling va ayting: ichida!
extra.boshqa_usul: Kubiklarni qutiga solib, keyin chiqarib o'ynang.
